meaning: to agree with someone about something
example: We don't always see eye to eye, but we respect each other.
origin: The exact origin is uncertain; the image is of two people looking at the same thing from the same point of view.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to look at someone very closely
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom is about agreeing with someone, not about the physical act of looking at them.
This is the opposite of the idiom, which describes having the same opinion.
The idiom has nothing to do with avoiding people; it describes shared opinions.

explanation: 'See eye to eye' means to agree with someone. It describes two people who share the same opinion or point of view about a topic.
